newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: VILNIUS BOURSE LISTS THREE NEW SHARES.
newsitem.headline: VILNIUS BOURSE LISTS THREE NEW SHARES.

text.p: Lithuania's stock exchange said on Tuesday that had it listed three new shares on the current list of the Vilnius bourse.
The bourse said in a statement that its board decided to list the following shares on the current list from May 19 and to allow them to be exchanged in block transactions and on the central market:
- Kedainiu Grudai ordinary shares, 495,298 shares with a face value of 10 litas.
- Pergale ordinary shares, 750,571 shares with a one litas face value.
- Statybos Apdailos Mashinos ordinary shares, 17,095,141 shares with a one litas face value.
The bourse said in a statement that the financial situation of Pergale and Statybos Apdailos Mashinos should be taken into account since they reported losses in 1996.
